name: dot-claude
description: Actually useful Claude Code plugins for knowledge work — skills that compound, guardrails that hold, and a second brain Claude maintains for you.

plugins.name: compound
plugins.description: Claude that gets better every week: corrects its own instructions after mistakes, turns twice-done tasks into reusable skills, and authors new skills to spec.

plugins.name: safeguard
plugins.description: Seatbelts for knowledge work: guided permission hardening with safe defaults, plus a read-only audit of everything Claude can currently see and do.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: A plain-markdown knowledge base Claude sets up and maintains: capture durable learnings, keep notes organized and linked, process the inbox, run daily notes.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Multi-source research with parallel analyst subagents: clarify scope, plan angles, analyze each source in depth, and synthesize with citations — filed into your knowledge base if you have one.
